# 1. Overview

This is the sixth and last of six notebooks for Extended Data Fig 1 (see
`4_build_plant_tree.Rmd` and `5_build_host_matrix.Rmd`). It assembles the figure
from the prepared trees and tables and performs no further data processing.

The figure comprises three aligned panels. On the left, the Danaini phylogeny
(`Danaini_in_HOSTS.newick`) is drawn with an adjacent strip encoding each
species' ATPα genotype. Along the top, the genus-level Apocynaceae and Moraceae
phylogeny built in `4_build_plant_tree.Rmd` is shown with tip points marking
genera known to contain cardenolides and with bars delimiting plant subfamilies
and families. At the centre, a presence/absence heatmap records host use for each
butterfly species by plant genus, with use of *Asclepias* highlighted. Rows are
ordered by the Danaini phylogeny and columns by the plant phylogeny.

```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(patchwork)

in_dir  <- "../input_data/host_matrix"
out_dir <- "../output_data/host_matrix"

clean_name <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_replace_all(as.character(x), "_", " "))
}

# "Danaus plexippus" -> "D. plexippus" for tip labels
abbr_tip <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_name(x)
  vapply(x, function(z) {
    parts <- strsplit(z, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) >= 2 && nchar(parts[1]) > 0)
      paste0(substr(parts[1], 1, 1), ". ", parts[2]) else z
  }, character(1))
}

# Tip order, top to bottom, exactly as ggtree draws it (ladderize = FALSE)
drawn_tip_order <- function(tree) {
  d <- ggtree(tree, ladderize = FALSE)$data
  d <- d[d$isTip, ]
  clean_name(d$label[order(d$y)])
}
```

# 2. Read prepared inputs

```{r read-inputs}
host_assoc <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "Ext_fig1_host_associations.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(butterfly_species = clean_name(butterfly_species),
         plant_genus       = str_squish(plant_genus))

plant_attr <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "Ext_fig1_plant_genus_attributes.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(plant_genus = str_squish(plant_genus))

atpa <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "Ext_fig1_butterfly_atpa.csv"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(butterfly_species = clean_name(butterfly_species))

danaini_tree <- read.tree(file.path(in_dir, "Danaini_in_HOSTS.newick"))
danaini_tree$tip.label <- clean_name(danaini_tree$tip.label)

plant_tree_full <- read.tree(
  file.path(in_dir, "Apo_Mora_phylo_tree/apocynaceae_moraceae_genus_tree.newick")
)
```

The Danaini tree is rotated to the tip orientation used in the ancestral-state
reconstruction figures (`Figure_2/code/Blanca_HOSTS_milkweed_asclepias_ASR.Rmd`),
so that Extended Data Fig 1 and Figure 2 present species in the same vertical
order. The reference order is taken from the species tree used there
(`danaini_reference_order.newick`); rotation only reorders the display and leaves
topology and branch lengths unchanged. Species absent from the reference (the
outgroup *Heliconius erato*) retain their topological placement.

```{r rotate-danaini}
reference_tree <- read.tree(file.path(in_dir, "danaini_reference_order.newick"))
reference_tree$tip.label <- clean_name(reference_tree$tip.label)

reference_order <- {
  d <- ggtree(reference_tree, ladderize = FALSE)$data
  d <- d[d$isTip, ]
  clean_name(d$label[order(d$y, decreasing = TRUE)])
}

# Place the outermost outgroup (Heliconius erato, absent from the reference) at
# the base alongside the other outgroups rather than at the top.
reference_order <- c(reference_order, "Heliconius erato")

danaini_tree <- ape::rotateConstr(
  danaini_tree,
  rev(intersect(reference_order, danaini_tree$tip.label))
)
```

# 3. Prune the plant tree to the genera in the matrix

```{r prune-plant-tree}
genera_in_matrix <- sort(unique(plant_attr$plant_genus))

missing_from_tree <- setdiff(genera_in_matrix, plant_tree_full$tip.label)
if (length(missing_from_tree) > 0) {
  message("Plant genera in the matrix but absent from the tree (dropped): ",
          paste(missing_from_tree, collapse = ", "))
}

plant_tree <- keep.tip(
  plant_tree_full,
  intersect(plant_tree_full$tip.label, genera_in_matrix)
) %>%
  ladderize()

cat("Plant genera plotted:", length(plant_tree$tip.label), "\n")
```

# 4. Orders and the plotting grid

Row order from the Danaini tree, column order from the plant tree. The full
butterfly x genus grid is filled with 0 (absent) where there is no association.

```{r grid}
row_order <- drawn_tip_order(danaini_tree)                 # butterfly species
col_order <- drawn_tip_order(plant_tree)                   # plant genera

# Only genera that survived tree pruning can be columns
col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% plant_tree$tip.label]

df_tile <- tidyr::crossing(
  butterfly_species = row_order,
  plant_genus       = col_order
) %>%
  left_join(
    host_assoc %>% select(butterfly_species, plant_genus, tile_state),
    by = c("butterfly_species", "plant_genus")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tile_state = replace_na(tile_state, "Absent"),
    tile_state = factor(tile_state, levels = c("Absent", "Present", "Asclepias")),
    butterfly_species = factor(butterfly_species, levels = row_order),
    plant_genus       = factor(plant_genus,       levels = col_order)
  )
```

# 5. Heatmap panel

```{r heatmap}
p_tile <- ggplot(df_tile,
                 aes(x = plant_genus, y = butterfly_species, fill = tile_state)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Host use",
    values = c("Absent" = "white", "Present" = "black", "Asclepias" = "#885ca6"),
    breaks = c("Absent", "Present", "Asclepias"),
    labels = c("Absent", "Present", "Asclepias"),
    drop   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = col_order, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = row_order, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    axis.text    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin  = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )
```

# 6. Danaini tree panel (with ATPα strip)

```{r danaini-tree}
atpa_levels  <- c("VSH", "VSN", "LSN", "LAN", "QAN", "unknown")
atpa_palette <- c("VSH" = "#ed1c2c", "VSN" = "#f36f21", "LSN" = "#fec12b",
                  "LAN" = "#3a6a9e", "QAN" = "grey30", "unknown" = "grey80")

# One-column matrix of ATPα state per tip, in tree-tip order (rownames = tips)
dan_plot <- danaini_tree
dan_plot$tip.label <- abbr_tip(dan_plot$tip.label)

atpa_by_abbr <- atpa %>%
  mutate(tip = abbr_tip(butterfly_species)) %>%
  distinct(tip, atpa_state)

atpa_mat <- tibble(tip = dan_plot$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(atpa_by_abbr, by = "tip") %>%
  mutate(atpa_state = factor(replace_na(atpa_state, "unknown"),
                             levels = atpa_levels)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("tip")

p_base <- ggtree(dan_plot, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE, size = 0.3)
dan_xmax <- max(p_base$data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
p_base <- p_base + xlim(0, dan_xmax * 1.45)

p_dan_tree <- gheatmap(
  p_base, atpa_mat, offset = 0.05, width = 0.025, colnames = FALSE, color = NA
) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, offset = 0.75, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = expression("ATP" * alpha * " state"),
    values = atpa_palette, breaks = atpa_levels, drop = FALSE
  )
```

# 7. Plant tree panel (cardenolides + subfamily/family bars)

The subfamily and family bars are derived from the drawn tip order rather than
hard-coded: for each group the bar spans from its first to its last tip as the
tree is drawn.

```{r plant-tree}
plant_order <- drawn_tip_order(plant_tree)

# Annotation for tip points: cardenolide presence per genus
anno_carden <- plant_attr %>%
  filter(plant_genus %in% plant_tree$tip.label) %>%
  transmute(label = plant_genus,
            cardenolide_state = if_else(known_cardenolide == 1L,
                                        "Present", "Absent"))

# Helper: endpoints (first/last tip in drawn order) for a set of genera
strip_ends <- function(genera) {
  g <- plant_order[plant_order %in% genera]
  if (length(g) == 0) return(NULL)
  c(first = g[1], last = g[length(g)])
}

# Build the group -> genera map for the bars
attr_lut <- plant_attr %>% filter(plant_genus %in% plant_tree$tip.label)
groups <- list(
  "Rauvolfioideae" = attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_subfamily %in% "Rauvolfioideae"],
  "Apocynoideae"   = attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_subfamily %in% "Apocynoideae"],
  "Periplocoideae" = attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_subfamily %in% "Periplocoideae"],
  "Asclepiadoideae & Secamonoideae (milkweed lineages)" =
    attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_subfamily %in%
                           c("Asclepiadoideae", "Secamonoideae")],
  "Apocynaceae"    = attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_family == "Apocynaceae"],
  "Moraceae"       = attr_lut$plant_genus[attr_lut$plant_family == "Moraceae"]
)
# Offsets: family bars sit outside subfamily bars
group_offset <- c(
  "Rauvolfioideae" = 30, "Apocynoideae" = 30, "Periplocoideae" = 30,
  "Asclepiadoideae & Secamonoideae (milkweed lineages)" = 30,
  "Apocynaceae" = 23, "Moraceae" = 23
)

p_apoc_tree <- ggtree(plant_tree, branch.length = "none", ladderize = FALSE,
                      size = 0.3) %<+% anno_carden +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = cardenolide_state), size = 1.5) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3, angle = 90, hjust = 1, offset = -3, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Cardenolides",
                     values = c("Absent" = "grey80", "Present" = "black")) +
  xlim_tree(1) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off")

for (grp in names(groups)) {
  ends <- strip_ends(groups[[grp]])
  if (is.null(ends)) next
  p_apoc_tree <- p_apoc_tree +
    geom_strip(ends[["first"]], ends[["last"]], label = grp,
               fontsize = 3, barsize = 0.3, color = "black",
               offset = group_offset[[grp]], offset.text = 3, hjust = 0.5)
}

p_apoc_tree <- p_apoc_tree +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5, 5, 5.5))
```

# 8. Combine and save

```{r combine, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
fig_final <- plot_spacer() + p_apoc_tree + p_dan_tree + p_tile +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 2), heights = c(1, 2.2),
              guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

fig_final

ggsave("../visuals/host_matrix/Ext_Fig1_butterfly_x_plant.pdf", fig_final,
       width = 12, height = 10)
```
